matches.note: Buff Butterfly wins with the "Buff Buster" at 5:03.
Billed for the World Women's Championship. Double countout at 2:34; the promotion's own commentary calls Freefall "the final RCCW Womens World Champion" as the title is retired the same night.

Billed for the World Television Championship. Crackshot interferes with a chair and a finishing move on L-Mo; Carnage adds a top-rope strike. Declared No Contest; Freefall and Jason Creed carry L-Mo to the back.
Jason Creed wins by pinfall with a standing corkscrew leg whip at 6:12. Immediately afterward, the returning Demon Within and Grendle attack the beaten Quezzy.

Billed for the World Cruiserweight Championship (Piston's own in-ring words instead call the belt his "LightHeavyweight Title"). Piston attacks Black Jack Dealer before the bell, knocks him out, and leaves the ring — and the promotion — with the title rather than defend it. No fall or finish is declared.

The promotion's own card billed this as champion vs. champion (Clutch's World Heavyweight Championship against a second singles title the commentary also calls "World Hardcore," a naming the card's own earlier Hardcore title match already used for a different belt). Contested inside a cage with kendo sticks; ends with both men leaving the cage, destroying the timekeeper's table, then trading championship belts and shaking hands rather than settling the bout. No fall or finish is declared.
